name: modern-web-guidance-src
description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
one_liner: A free cheat-sheet library that stops AI coding assistants from writing old-fashioned, bloated website code by feeding them the latest best practices as they work.
buyer: No direct business buyer — this is a free, Google-stewarded reference tool for developers, not something a non-technical business would purchase.
business_use_cases: A freelance web developer installs it so their AI assistant stops suggesting outdated jQuery patterns and instead uses modern, faster browser APIs.
An agency bakes it into their internal coding agent setup to keep client websites consistently fast and accessible without manual code review for every pattern.
A web performance consultancy uses its 'legacy-scan' feature to quickly audit a client's existing codebase for outdated patterns to fix.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'website modernization audit' service for small businesses, using the legacy-scan tool as the core engine

steal_this: Run the legacy-scan tool against local small-business websites, bundle the findings into a simple one-page report, and sell $200 'speed up your website' audits this weekend.
